searchText: accessLists is an array of arrays because you can specify multiple accounts, and for each account you can specify multiple storage. Thus 2D. See https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2930#specification That's clear, but there is one additional top-level array of these. It is also unclear if access list should be ignored or used before London.
